Yes—Plan B gives you later morning starts:

- A: CAP4000 Monday/Wednesday, 8–9:15 a.m.
- B: CAP4000 Tuesday/Thursday, 10–11:40 a.m., leaving 20 minutes before your noon work shift.

B avoids 8 a.m. classes, but adds Tuesday classes and puts Thursday class before work. A concentrates classes on fewer days. Both keep the Thursday 5:30–6:20 p.m. lab.

Both satisfy the required course, lab, prerequisites, and 12–16 credit limit, with no class or work overlaps. B is better if later mornings matter most and 20 minutes is enough to reach work.

Your saved Plan A and current enrollment remain unchanged.
